# Infinite Storage Plugin:
	Infinite Storage Plugin: Keeps the inventory intact,
	regardless of whether items are removed or added;
	No updates are made to the Infinite Storage once it is enabled.
    
    - Enderchests, bundles and hoppers are not supported as storage blocks.
    - Plugin data remains saved across server restarts or reloads.
    - You can change the messages in your own language (use the messages.yml file).

## Plugin user scope:
	- Dispenser

## Plugin admin scope:
	- Barrel
	- Chest
	- Copper Chest (All Variants)
	- Dispenser
	- Dropper
	- Shulker Box (All Colors)
	- Trapped Chest

![Blocks Tested 1.21.8](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c1a886aadc330ee2683dd0e65a97499572ab5ac8.jpeg)

## User:
	1.	User must have the plugin permission:
```
infinitestorage.user
```
	2.	User may only use infinite "Dispenser".
	3.	User must be able to use commands.

		1.	/infinite add
			> Add an "Infinite Storage".
		2.	/infinite info
			> Show whether the "Infinite Storage" is enabled.
		3.	/infinite list
			> Show where the "Infinite Storage" blocks are.
		4.	/infinite remove
			> Remove one of their own "Infinite Storage" blocks.
		5.	/infinite remove all
			> Remove all of their own "Infinite Storages".

	4.	If the user breaks the block with "Infinite Storage", the Infinite Storage must also be removed.
	5.	Commands can also be shortened with "/inf" instead of "/infinite".

## Admin:
	1.	Admin must have the plugin permission:
```
infinitestorage.admin
```
	2.	Admin may use infinite Barrel/All Chests/Dispenser/Dropper/Shulker Box (all colors).
	3.	Admin must be able to use commands.

		1.	/infinite add
			> Add an "Infinite Storage".
		2.	/infinite info
			> Show whether the "Infinite Storage" is enabled.
		3.	/infinite list
			> Show where the "Infinite Storage" blocks are.
		4.	/infinite list [username]
			> Show where the "Infinite Storage" blocks of one user are.
		5.	/infinite remove
			> Remove one "Infinite Storage".
		6.	/infinite remove all
			> Remove all players' "Infinite Storages".

	4.	If the admin breaks the block with "Infinite Storage", the Infinite Storage must also be removed.
	5.	Commands can also be shortened with "/inf" instead of "/infinite".

![Commands Tested 1.21.8](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/820757fdcba2969c02b10a51e5d765ec8f9a3848.jpeg)
